implement.summary: Gap on BASE_SHA 55d80326: docs/RELEASE_READINESS_2026-09-07.md §11 lists H04-ADVISORIES as OPEN ('Fresh workspace/mobile dependency audit and reachability assessment required'); the only prior disposition is one row in docs/SECURITY_CERTIFICATION_2026-08-30.md:119 covering image-size only, and no docs/security/ directory existed. Fresh audits on the base show a NEW advisory family since that certification: GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr (CVE-2026-45822, published 2026-08-31) on decode-uri-component@0.2.2, reached via @react-navigation/native@7.3.18 → @react-navigation/core@7.21.13 → query-string@7.1.3 (apps/mobile/package-lock.json), whose vulnerable decodeComponent() is called from query-string/index.js:233 inside queryString.parse(), invoked by @react-navigation/core/src/getStateFromPath.tsx:879 — i.e. it IS in the shipped iOS bundle, unlike image-size. Work done: ran pnpm audit (root, 0 advisories), npm audit in apps/mobile (16 labels → 3 GHSA advisories in 2 packages), deno audit on both deno.lock files (0 advisories), a frozen-lock Deno 2.5.6 typecheck of supabase/functions/api/index.ts, an npm cross-check of the 13 npm packages in the Deno lock, fetched authoritative GHSA metadata via `gh api /advisories/<id>`, and built a `--dev false` iOS JS bundle to scan module presence. Dispositions (all written to docs/security/ADVISORIES_2026-09-08.md, the only write_path): (1)+(2) image-size GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr / GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq — ACCEPTED RISK: executes only in metro/src/Assets.js:72,177 on the build machine over committed repo assets (64 png + 1 mp4, no icns/jxl/heif), 0 modules from image-size/metro/metro-config/metro-transform-worker/@react-native/metro-config/community-cli-plugin/new-app-screen in the production bundle, no patched release exists (first_patched_version null; metro@0.87.0 latest still ^1.0.2), npm's proposed 'fix' is a react-native 0.87.1→0.86.3 downgrade — rejected. (3) decode-uri-component GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr — ACCEPTED RISK: bundled but unreachable — apps/mobile/src/navigation/RootNavigator.tsx:550 renders NavigationContainer without a `linking` prop, so @react-navigation/native NavigationContainer.tsx:81 sets isLinkingEnabled=false and useLinking.native.tsx returns before getStateFromURL in both the url listener (:190) and getInitialState (:158); no app code calls getStateFromPath/useLinkTo/useLinkProps; the only URL scheme (Info.plist CFBundleURLTypes) is Google Sign-In's, handled natively; entitlements hold only applesignin. Upgrade rejected on compatibility, not age: decode-uri-component@0.5.0 (published 2026-06-29, ≥7 days) is ESM-only (type=module, exports default) while query-string@7.1.3 is CJS `require('decode-uri-component')` called as a function — an overrides pin would make queryString.parse() throw; the upstream fix (query-string ^9.4.0) is only in @react-navigation/core 8.0.0-alpha.*. No dependency, lockfile, override, or Edge pin was changed. Re-review triggers recorded: enabling deep linking / universal links, image-size shipping a patch, @react-navigation 8 going stable. No regression test added: the write_path is documentation-only and the objective is an audit/disposition, not a behaviour change. No PR opened per instructions.

breaks.expected: A check that claims 'exits non-zero unless every advisory has a disposition' should exit 1 when an advisory in the report cannot be mapped to a dispositioned id — e.g. treat an unidentifiable via/advisory entry as MISSING, or fail when metadata.vulnerabilities.total > 0 while zero ids were extracted.
breaks.observed: A5: mobile.json with one vulnerability whose via.url is https://www.npmjs.com/advisories/1234 -> check prints 'advisories=0 missing=0', exit 0. A6: via.url=null -> exit 0. A7: pnpm.json advisory with severity=high but no github_advisory_id -> exit 0 while pnpm metadata says high:1. A8: mobile metadata total=16/high=9/moderate=7 with zero GHSA-bearing via entries -> 'advisories=0 missing=0', exit 0. Positive/negative controls A1-A4 and malformed-report control A9 behave as documented (exit 0 / exit 1). Realism caveat: today's npm registry always emits github.com/advisories/GHSA-… urls and pnpm always sets github_advisory_id, so B1/B2 on the real tree give the documented result; the fail-open needs a report shape the current registry does not produce. This weakens what the check PROVES ('every GHSA id with a disposition', which is what §8.2(b) literally says) versus what the acceptance criterion asks ('every advisory has a disposition').

residual_risks: image-size (GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr, GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq) remains installed at 1.2.1 via metro@0.87.0: build-machine-only (Metro asset pipeline), absent from the production bundle, inputs are committed assets; worst case is a hung react-native bundle. decode-uri-component@0.2.2 (GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr) is bundled in the shipped app via @react-navigation/core -> query-string@7.1.3 but unreachable while NavigationContainer has no `linking` prop and there are no universal links / JS-handled URL schemes. Any PR adding deep linking, associated domains, or a JS URL handler makes it attacker-reachable (JS-thread stall from a crafted link) and must first land a navigation stack depending on query-string>=9.4.0.

The frozen manifest command's own shell status is 1 whenever any advisory exists (npm audit semantics), so a kind=check on that command alone can only be 0 in an advisory-free tree; the acceptance record grades the stated criterion via the section 8.2 check and records the raw exit 1 in note. If the judge requires the bare manifest command to exit 0, that is unsatisfiable without an unsafe dependency change or exit-code suppression, both of which are forbidden.
